name: Gandhidham

queries.query: Gandhidham Gujarat official cadastral parcel map land records Bhunaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Gujarat Revenue Department land-record/property-card services, the official Directorate of Land Records link, the official Kutch district land-record custodian context, and a Gandhidham Development Authority survey-number search page. No public parcel feature endpoint was established.

queries.query: ગાંધીધામ ગુજરાત સત્તાવાર જમીન રેકોર્ડ નકશો ભુનકશા
queries.result: Gujarati-language first-party discovery surfaced the Gujarat Revenue Department's Gujarati-enabled official site and the same official land-record/property-card services. Search results did not expose a public Gandhidham parcel API or safe geometry response.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Gujarati first-party discovery followed by bounded TLS-verified anonymous GET attempts. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS disablement were used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Government of Gujarat Revenue Department page. It identifies survey, settlement, city-survey and the Settlement Commissioner/Superintendent of Land Records, and links to AnyRoR and e-Milkat; it is custodian/service evidence, not parcel geometry.
Gandhidham Development Authority page titled Search By Survey Number. It is a local development-authority service route, but no safe result or geometry was retrieved.
Official Gujarat district map PDF naming Gandhidham and the Settlement Commissionerate/Land Records context; cartographic administrative evidence only.
Official Department of Land Resources directory lists Gujarat's E-Dhara, Bhunaksha Gujarat and E-Milkat service categories; national directory metadata is not citywide geometry evidence.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified anonymous curl request timed out after 20 seconds before HTML/JavaScript configuration was returned. No service route, schema, CRS, native ID or geometry was obtained. This is a route failure, not evidence of citywide absence.

TLS-verified anonymous curl request failed certificate validation because the host certificate was expired. The authorized policy did not permit a source-specific TLS exception, so the request was not retried insecurely; no form response, schema, ID or geometry was obtained.
Official page retrieved. It exposed service links to AnyRoR, e-Milkat and iORA plus the land-record custodian, but no parcel feature response.
Official directory retrieved. Gujarat service categories were confirmed; no Gandhidham parcel geometry or public API was returned.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Gujarat official Revenue/land-record services, Gandhidham Development Authority survey-number route, and Kutch district administrative land-record context.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local/state custodian and service existence only; no open Gandhidham parcel geometry coverage, schema or CRS verified.

remainingUncertainty: The current Gujarat maps JavaScript/configuration, public API route, Gandhidham city-survey unit identifiers, parcel schema, CRS, stable native identity, update currency and citywide completeness remain unresolved. The exact WUP point was preserved and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made. A timeout, certificate failure or unusable UI is not evidence of cadastral absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect the Gujarat/Gandhidham service through an available valid public route and request only bounded anonymous native ID-plus-geometry data. Serial reviewer qualification remains required; runtime readiness stays held.
